results.name: 1. Telemetry & Current State Record Count
results.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as current_state_count FROM postgres.public.asset_current_state;

results.name: 2. Distinct Asset Inventory & Types
results.query: SELECT DISTINCT asset_id, asset_type, operating_mode FROM postgres.public.asset_current_state ORDER BY asset_id;

results.name: 3. Fleet Health Distribution & KPI Metrics
results.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as total, AVG(health_score) as avg_health, MIN(health_score) as min_health, MAX(health_score) as max_health FROM postgres.public.asset_current_state;

results.name: 4. High Failure Risk Asset Prognostics
results.query: SELECT asset_id, failure_probability, predicted_rul_hours, health_state FROM postgres.public.asset_current_state WHERE failure_probability >= 0.50 ORDER BY failure_probability DESC;

results.name: 5. Multi-Sensor Operational Telemetry Aggregates
results.query: SELECT asset_type, AVG(temperature) as avg_temp, AVG(vibration) as avg_vib, AVG(pressure) as avg_press FROM postgres.public.asset_current_state GROUP BY asset_type;

results.name: 6. Prescriptive Maintenance Ranking Queue
results.query: SELECT ranking, asset_id, maintenance_priority, priority_score, recommended_action FROM postgres.public.maintenance_priority_queue ORDER BY ranking ASC;

results.name: 7. Streaming Anomaly Alerts Audit
results.query: SELECT severity, COUNT(*) as alert_count FROM postgres.public.asset_alert_history GROUP BY severity;

results.name: 8. Cross-Catalog TPCH Federated Baseline
results.query: SELECT count(*) as tpch_customer_count FROM tpch.sf1.customer;

results.name: 9. Executive Fleet KPI Snapshots
results.query: SELECT total_assets, healthy_assets, critical_assets, fleet_health_score, avg_predicted_rul_hours FROM postgres.public.fleet_kpi_snapshots ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1;

results.name: 10. Historical Prognostic Progression Trajectory
results.query: SELECT asset_id, COUNT(*) as prediction_points, AVG(failure_probability) as mean_fail_prob, AVG(predicted_rul_hours) as mean_rul FROM postgres.public.asset_prediction_history GROUP BY asset_id ORDER BY asset_id;
